title: This Is Your Brain On Music

questions.q: What role does music play in human evolution according to most scientists?
a: It is only a pleasure byproduct
questions.why: Levitin states music paved the way for speech development.

questions.q: Why do people often feel emotional when "Here Comes The Bride" plays?
questions.why: Familiarity and prediction of the tune trigger emotion.

questions.q: What creates a lasting imprint in the brain the first time a song is heard?
a: A unique set of neurons firing together
questions.why: Levitin describes a specific neuronal pattern forming an imprint.

questions.q: Which brain areas are activated simultaneously during music listening?
questions.why: The book lists these regions lighting up together.

questions.q: What balances comfort and excitement in a great song?
questions.why: Levitin says great songs surprise without being too unexpected.
